citation: Menna and Poulain (2014), Geostrophic currents and kinetic energies in the Black Sea estimated from merged drifter and satellite altimetry data, Ocean Science 10, 155-165, doi:10.5194/os-10-155-2014.
definition_locator: Equation 6, printed page 158 / PDF page 4; section 3.2.2, printed page 159 / PDF page 5; Figure 5 and caption, printed page 162 / PDF page 8.
residual_ke_definition: One half of the sum of squares of daily surface geostrophic velocity residuals after subtraction of the mean unbiased velocity field, per unit mass; meridionally averaged over 41 to 42.5 N for the Anatolian Hovmoller diagram.
limitations: The source generally-below qualifier is not an absolute maximum and does not bound every day.
The interaction excess is a joint regional activity signal; it is not apportioned to either eddy and does not supply two independent observations.
KE uses velocity residuals and meridional averaging. No total speed, swirl speed or eddy size is recovered by a square-root conversion.
Month windows are disjoint source supports, not formation/dissipation times, continuous duration or seasonal extrema.
The source figure color scale ends below the stated prose exceedance; retain the source prose without estimating values from saturated colors.
